publisher_or_authors: Madaan, Tandon, Gupta, et al. · academic · 2023
summary: Shows a frozen model can improve its own output by generating critiques and revising the same draft. Demonstrates test-time self-improvement without weight updates. Establishes the critique-and-revise loop as a reusable pattern.
title: Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback
why: Canonical loop-engineering primitive: generate -> self-critique -> revise.
